## Extra Checks and Visualizations

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

```


### Phase 1: DGP-related charts

1) Default rate per year


```{r}


# ── Aggregate by observation year ────────────────────────────────────
year_stats <- dat %>%
  group_by(obs_year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_obs        = n(),
    n_defaults   = sum(default),
    default_rate = mean(default),
    .groups      = "drop"
  )

# ── Scaling factor for dual axis ────────────────────────────────────
# Maps the right-axis (count) to the left-axis (rate) range
max_rate  <- max(year_stats$default_rate) * 1.15
max_count <- max(year_stats$n_obs) * 1.15
scale_factor <- max_rate / max_count

# ── Plot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggplot(year_stats, aes(x = obs_year)) +
  # Bars: firm-year count (scaled to rate axis)
  geom_col(aes(y = n_obs * scale_factor),
           fill = "grey75", width = 0.7) +
  # Line: default rate
  geom_line(aes(y = default_rate),
            colour = "#1a3a5c", linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = default_rate),
             colour = "#1a3a5c", size = 2.2) +
  # Dual axes
  scale_y_continuous(
    name   = "Ausfallrate",
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 0.1),
    limits = c(0, max_rate),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / scale_factor,
                        name   = "Fallzahl",
                        labels = scales::comma_format())
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(min(year_stats$obs_year), max(year_stats$obs_year), by = 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Simulated Default Rate and Portfolio Size by Year",
    x     = "Jahr"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
  )

# ── Optional: print the table too ───────────────────────────────────
cat("\n── Year-level summary ──\n")
print(year_stats, n = 30)

```

### Function Checks Before Impairment / Modeling

```{r}

# ── DGP Checks ────────────────────────────────

# Do deteriorating firms actually have rising debt-equity and falling interest coverage over time?
det_firms <- dat[dat$trajectory == "deteriorating", ]
cat("Deteriorating firms — mean dte year 1:", 
    round(mean(det_firms$debt_to_equity[det_firms$years_on_book == 1]), 3), "\n")
cat("Deteriorating firms — mean dte year 3+:", 
    round(mean(det_firms$debt_to_equity[det_firms$years_on_book >= 3]), 3), "\n")
cat("Deteriorating firms — mean ic year 1:", 
    round(mean(det_firms$interest_cov[det_firms$years_on_book == 1]), 3), "\n")
cat("Deteriorating firms — mean ic year 3+:", 
    round(mean(det_firms$interest_cov[det_firms$years_on_book >= 3]), 3), "\n")


# ── Are sector rates / trends accurate? ────────────────────────────────

# Overall sector default rates (firm-year level)
cat("Default rates per sector (1: services / 2: gastro / 3: manufacturing):\n", 
    tapply(dat$default, dat$sector, mean), "\n",
    "Target: sector 1 ≈ 0.020, sector 2 ≈ 0.036, sector 3 ≈ 0.023\n")

# Gastro trend over time
cat("Over-time default rate increases for Gastro per year (note low base on the tails):\n", 
    round(tapply(dat$default[dat$sector == 2], dat$obs_year[dat$sector == 2], mean), 3), "\n")




```

```{r}
# ── All Impairment Functions ────────────────────────────────

# Assumes the following objects exist in your environment:
# dat                                        (clean data)
# dat_mcar_mild,    dat_mcar_severe
# dat_mnar_mild,    dat_mnar_severe
# dat_noise_mild,   dat_noise_severe
# dat_impl_mild,    dat_impl_severe


# ── 1. Missing rates (MCAR MAR & MNAR) ────────────────────────────────────────

# Within the expected column! E.g. MAR only for CREFO, MNAR only for Interest Coverage

cat("=== Missing Rates ===\n")
cat("MCAR mild:  ", round(mean(is.na(dat_mcar_mild$interest_cov)), 3),  "\n")
cat("MCAR severe:", round(mean(is.na(dat_mcar_severe$interest_cov)), 3), "\n")
cat("MAR mild:  ", round(mean(is.na(dat_mar_mild$crefo)), 3),  "\n")
cat("MAR severe:", round(mean(is.na(dat_mar_severe$crefo)), 3), "\n")
cat("MNAR mild:  ", round(mean(is.na(dat_mnar_mild$interest_cov)), 3),  "\n")
cat("MNAR severe:", round(mean(is.na(dat_mnar_severe$interest_cov)), 3), "\n")


```

```{r}

# ──  2. MNAR getting worse by int_cov quartile ─────────────────────────
cat("\n=== MNAR: Missing Rate by Interest Coverage Quartile ===\n")
ic_bins <- cut(dat$interest_cov, breaks = 4)

cat("Mild:\n")
print(round(tapply(is.na(dat_mnar_mild$interest_cov), ic_bins, mean), 3))

cat("Severe:\n")
print(round(tapply(is.na(dat_mnar_severe$interest_cov), ic_bins, mean), 3))

```

```{r}
# ── 3. Noise inflated SD ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("\n=== Noise: SD Before and After ===\n")
noise_vars <- c("log_assets", "debt_to_equity", "interest_cov")

for (v in noise_vars) {
  cat(sprintf("%-20s clean SD: %.4f | mild SD: %.4f | severe SD: %.4f\n",
    v,
    sd(dat[[v]]),
    sd(dat_noise_mild[[v]]),
    sd(dat_noise_severe[[v]])
  ))
}
```

```{r}

# ── 4. Implausible values are present ─────────────────────────────────────

cat("\n=== Implausible: Range Summary of Affected Variables ===\n")
impl_vars <- c("log_assets", "debt_to_equity", "interest_cov", "firm_age")

for (v in impl_vars) {
  cat(sprintf("\n%s:\n", v))
  cat("  mild:   min =", round(min(dat_impl_mild[[v]]),  2),
              " max =", round(max(dat_impl_mild[[v]]),  2), "\n")
  cat("  severe: min =", round(min(dat_impl_severe[[v]]), 2),
              " max =", round(max(dat_impl_severe[[v]]), 2), "\n")
}

# Domain-invalid checks
cat("\nDomain violations (proportion of rows):\n")
cat("  Negative debt_to_equity — mild:", round(mean(dat_impl_mild$debt_to_equity   < 0), 3),
                                "| severe:", round(mean(dat_impl_severe$debt_to_equity  < 0), 3), "\n")
cat("  Negative firm_age       — mild:", round(mean(dat_impl_mild$firm_age          < 0), 3),
                                "| severe:", round(mean(dat_impl_severe$firm_age         < 0), 3), "\n")


```

```{r}
# ── 5a. Visual distributions: Noise ───────────────────────────────────────

par(mfrow = c(3, 3), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))

for (v in c("log_assets", "debt_to_equity", "interest_cov")) {
  hist(dat[[v]],             main = paste("Clean -", v),        xlab = v, col = "grey90")
  hist(dat_noise_mild[[v]],  main = paste("Noise mild -", v),   xlab = v, col = "lightblue")
  hist(dat_noise_severe[[v]], main = paste("Noise severe -", v), xlab = v, col = "steelblue")
}

# ── 5b. Visual distributions: Implausible ─────────────────────────────────

par(mfrow = c(1, 3), mar = c(5, 4, 3, 1), oma = c(0, 0, 3, 0))
for (v in c("log_assets", "debt_to_equity", "interest_cov")) {
  boxplot(
    dat[[v]], dat_impl_mild[[v]], dat_impl_severe[[v]],
    names   = c("Clean", "Mild", "Severe"),
    main    = v,
    col     = c("grey80", "lightyellow", "orange"),
    outline = TRUE,
    las     = 2
  )
}
mtext("Implausible Values Impairment: Distribution by Severity", 
      outer = TRUE, cex = 1.1, font = 2, line = 1)
```

```{r}
# ── 6. Metadata tags ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("\n=== Metadata Tags ===\n")
for (nm in c("dat_mcar_mild", "dat_mcar_severe",
             "dat_mnar_mild", "dat_mnar_severe",
             "dat_noise_mild", "dat_noise_severe",
             "dat_impl_mild", "dat_impl_severe")) {
  cat(nm, "→ type:", attr(get(nm), "impairment")$type,
      "| severity:", attr(get(nm), "impairment")$severity, "\n")
}
```

```{r}
# ── 8. Crefo Score: Distribution by Sector ────────────────────────────────

par(mfrow = c(1, 3), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))

for (s in 1:3) {
  label <- c("1 (Services)", "2 (Gastro)", "3 (Manufacturing)")[s]
  subset <- dat$crefo[dat$sector == s]
  hist(subset, main = paste("Crefo - Sector", label),
       xlab = "crefo", col = c("grey90", "lightblue", "salmon")[s],
       xlim = c(100, 600), breaks = 20)
  abline(v = median(subset), lty = 2, lwd = 2)
  legend("topright", legend = paste("median:", round(median(subset))),
         bty = "n", cex = 0.9)
}

cat("\n=== Crefo Median by Sector ===\n")
for (s in 1:3) {
  label <- c("services", "gastro", "manufacturing")[s]
  cat(sprintf("Sector %d (%-15s): median = %.0f, mean = %.1f\n",
    s, label,
    median(dat$crefo[dat$sector == s]),
    mean(dat$crefo[dat$sector == s])
  ))
}
```

```{r}
# ── 10. Crefo Missing Rate by Sector ───────────────────────────────────────

cat("\n=== Crefo Missing Rate by Sector (MAR Diagnostic) ===\n")

for (nm in c("dat_mar_mild", "dat_mar_severe")) {
  d <- get(nm)
  miss_by_sector <- tapply(is.na(d$crefo), d$sector, mean)
  cat(sprintf("%-14s 1 (services): %.3f | 2 (gastro): %.3f | 3 (manufacturing): %.3f\n",
    nm, miss_by_sector["1"], miss_by_sector["2"], miss_by_sector["3"]
  ))
}

```
